Operational_Definition_66: Sum of delay across affected calls in the defined analysis window
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Not unique-vessel delay; disclose call weighting.

Operational_Definition_66: Delay at the final observed/simulated call for each vessel
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Report distribution across vessels, not only maximum.

Operational_Definition_66: Maximum final or accumulated vessel delay, clearly specified
Maximum simultaneous active calls in the defined network/window
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Not berth occupancy or validated congestion.

Operational_Definition_66: Duration network concurrency exceeds a predeclared threshold
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Threshold must be justified and is not berth capacity.

Operational_Definition_66: Time from disruption onset until the selected recovery criterion is met
Count remaining outside the recovery criterion at the end of the window
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Define denominator and treatment of right-censoring.

Operational_Definition_66: Delay summarized by port using consistent aggregation
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Distinguish per-port mean from pooled network mean.

Operational_Definition_66: Count of decisions violating explicitly modelled constraints
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Only meaningful if constraints and operational evidence exist.

Operational_Definition_66: Cost of delay, diversion, fuel or service disruption
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Not computable without defensible cost and route/fuel inputs.

Operational_Definition_66: Change in emissions from additional time, speed or rerouting
Interpretation_Guardrail_66: Not computable without vessel, fuel, speed and route data.
